title: 🌳 Identical Trees
description: ✅ Both trees have identical structure and matching node values.

title: 🔀 Different Structure
description: ❌ The trees contain the same values but have different structures.

title: 🔢 Different Values
description: ❌ The trees have the same structure but different corresponding values.

title: 🈳 Both Empty
description: 🌱 Both trees are empty and therefore structurally identical.

title: ⚖️ One Empty
description: ❌ One tree is empty while the other contains a node.

title: 🍃 Single Node Match
description: ✅ Both trees contain one node with the same value.

title: 🚫 Single Node Mismatch
description: ❌ The single nodes contain different values.
